rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: the child repeats essentially the entire recital-and-operative structure, with the same singular railroad-carrier formulation, the same employee representative, the same Pennsylvania-specific interruption finding, and the same reporting and status-quo machinery. The principal substantive substitution is Union Railroad Company for Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company. C05 is virtually identical but older; C08 is also very close, though adapted to Ohio.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Union Railroad Company (Pittsburgh), a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same detailed party-and-representation sentence is reused with only the railroad changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the State of Pennsylvania to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the State of Pennsylvania to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: This geographically specific factual recital is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Union Railroad Company (Pittsburgh) or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company or this employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory status-quo mechanism and sentence structure are reused, substituting the carrier name.
